Generate correlated noise for negative-control models (internal)

Source: R/nc_models.R
dot-generate_nc_noise.Rd

When noise_cor is a valid p x p correlation matrix, draws n samples from MVN(0, noise_cor) and scales by sd0. Returns an n x (2*p) matrix: columns 1:p are the "uncaptured" noise component and columns (p+1):(2*p) are the idiosyncratic noise component (both with the same correlation structure). When noise_cor is NULL, uses independent rnorm (backward compatible).

Usage

.generate_nc_noise(n, p, noise_cor, sd0)

Arguments

n

Number of samples.

p

Number of features.

noise_cor

A p x p correlation matrix, or NULL.

sd0

Idiosyncratic noise SD.

Value

An n x (2*p) numeric matrix.
